description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring W. R. Munasinghe as a member of the Angunakolapelessa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Angunakolapelessa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the returning officer. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and procedures for local authorities.
